title: PixelPax SMP
description: A Survival-RPG Minecraft server that focused on economy and resources
body:
**Welcome to PixelPax SMP Minecraft Server 🔥**

This server is located in Indonesia / Southeast Asia, In this server, you have to be the most wealthy person in the server! Or else you can just play peacefully at the server like mines, create a house, building a team and more!

This server DOES NOT uses any resource pack so you can play without lag or fps drop!
We DO NOT support any cheating on our server, if you seen one, please report them to our online staff or discord server and we will check on it immediately.

Also, we have Rank system based on Cosmic Objects with bunch of perks in it, you can afford any rank to support us keeping this server online!

So what are you waiting for? Come on join us and be the most wealthy person in the server!
